name: Solomon A. Berson
summary: American physician and researcher who co-developed radioimmunoassay.

name: Rosalyn Yalow
summary: American medical physicist and Nobel laureate who co-developed radioimmunoassay with Berson.

name: New York University Medical School
summary: Medical school where Berson enrolled and graduated near the top of his class.

name: Veterans Administration Hospital in the Bronx
summary: Hospital where Berson worked as an internist in the Radioisotope Unit.

name: Journal of Clinical Investigation
summary: Scientific journal that published Berson and Yalow's key papers.

name: Radioimmunoassay
summary: Analytical method for quantifying minute quantities of molecules in blood using antibodies and radioisotopes.

name: Nobel Prize
summary: Prestigious international award awarded to Yalow in 1977 for the development of immunoassay.

name: American Diabetes Association
summary: Organization that hosted the Banting Award Lecture given by Berson and Yalow.

name: Banting Award
summary: Award lecture delivered by Berson and Yalow to the American Diabetes Association.
